definitions.explanation: A meeting at which a public figure or organization gives a statement or answers questions from journalists.

examples.japanese: {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}を{開|ひら}く。
{首相|しゅしょう}が{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}で{声明|せいめい}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The prime minister issued a statement at the press conference.

examples.japanese: {緊急|きんきゅう}{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}が{夜|よる}{遅|おそ}くに{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: An emergency press conference was held late at night.

notes:
Composed of {記者|きしゃ} (journalist, reporter) + {会見|かいけん} (meeting, interview). One of the most common terms encountered in news media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a press conference
- {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}を{行|おこな}う: to conduct a press conference
- {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}に{出席|しゅっせき}する: to attend a press conference
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}: emergency press conference
- {共同|きょうどう}{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}: joint press conference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {会見|かいけん}: meeting or interview (broader; can be a private meeting, not just with press)
- {記者|きしゃ}{発表|はっぴょう}: press release or press announcement (often one-directional, without Q&A)
